theme: Racing to idle, or crawling to the deadline
title: DVFS Deadline Scheduling with Ramp-Sensitive Transitions
strategies: trivial: run the top DVFS level for the entire horizon, never idle -- reproduces the crudest always-feasible construction

greedy: race-to-idle -- top level whenever any job's window is open, idle the instant nothing is pending; pays full cubic power throughout every busy stretch and switches level exactly when work resumes, so ramp loss lands on the slot the deadline needed most

strong: tries a best-of several qualitatively different schedules per instance -- the cheapest feasible constant level for the whole horizon (exploiting power convexity), and pre-warmed / adaptive-rate schedules that shift each level switch one slot into the preceding idle gap (where the ramp loss is free) and track the actually-required rate instead of always maxing out
invalid: idles the entire horizon regardless of jobs -- misses every deadline, rejected before scoring
